articles.headline: Argentina respect Cape Verde in round of 32: Not here by chance
articles.description: Argentina manager Lionel Scaloni said his team has respect for Cape Verde after the opponent reached the round of 32 match on Friday night at Hard Rock Stadium through merit on the field.

articles.description: Cape Verde "believe" they can pull off one of the greatest World Cup shocks ever and stun Argentina, according to coach Pedro Leitao Brito.
